regime: Digestion Coil (Below Stops, Data Week Ahead)
summary: Quiet Monday after Friday's fireworks. Equities coiled just under their flipped stops. NQ closed 29,521, basically flat on the day at plus 0.04 percent, and MES closed 7,701, down 0.30 percent and sitting right on the 7,700 psych line. Gold steadied after the crash, down just 0.13 percent. The real move was crude: MCL ripped 3.45 percent to 86.31 and is now the strongest trend on the board, the lone long above a rising stop. Low volatility digestion heading into a data heavy week, ISM Tuesday and the jobs report Friday.
psychology: After a big reversal day the urge is to force the next trade. Today was a slow coil, and chop days punish over trading. Watch what NQ actually did: it broke below the opening range early, ran to 29,354, then ground all the way back to close at the highs. If you shorted the break and held for a trend, you got squeezed. The read is patience. Let price pick a side and accept there before you commit size. A handful of clean setups beats a stack of chop day scratches.

event.actual: No major US data today. The tape digested Friday's move in a low volatility grind. The 10 year yield eased to 4.724, down 0.11 percent, and VIX ticked up to 14.92 but stayed low.
event.surprise: None. A quiet, mechanical month-end session with no fresh macro shock.
event.nqReaction: NQ broke below the opening range early, bottomed at 29,354, then reversed and ground back to close 29,521.5, flat on the day. A coil, not a directional day.
event.crossAsset: Crude was the standout, breaking above 86 for a 3.45 percent gain. Gold steadied at 4,463 after Friday's 3.25 percent drop. Yields eased slightly and VIX stayed near 15.

risk.sizing: Keep size reduced. Equity direction is unresolved, still below falling stops but with the selling stalled into a data heavy week. This is a coil, and coils resolve fast once a catalyst hits. Crude is the one clean trend if you want directional exposure, sized normally with a stop under 84.74.
risk.openRisk: MNQ back above 29,541 or MES above 7,716 on two hourly closes flips the near term tone up. Losing the 7,700 psych on MES opens the 7,675 RTH low. Gold reclaiming 4,491 is the first real bounce signal; losing 4,450 reopens the downside. Crude stays long above 84.74.
risk.note: ISM Manufacturing Tuesday Sep 1 is the first real test, then JOLTS mid week and the August jobs report Friday Sep 4. Expect the coil to break on one of those prints. Carry reduced size until it does. Not financial advice.

fullReport.title: NY Opening Range / HTA OPEN
fullReport.html: HTA OPEN (NY opening range, 13:30 to 13:45 UTC window): OR high 29,517, OR low 29,390, width 127 points (0.43 percent). Price broke down through the OR low first, closing below it at 14:05 UTC (29,377.75), and ran to a 29,354 session low. Then it reversed and ground higher all session, only reclaiming the OR high late at 19:50 UTC (29,524.25) and closing 29,521.5 right at the top of the range. NYVWAP sat at 29,422 and price closed well above it, so buyers had the close. Signals: a failed downside break that recovered into the range, a back into range day. HOF (short only) had no clean continuation after the reversal, MID saw a two sided grind rather than a single first hour rejection, and BIR does not fire on Monday. For Tuesday, BIR, HOF, MID and BNC are all eligible, but ISM Manufacturing lands 10:00 ET right in the opening window, so keep the first opening range break on a short leash.

fullReport.title: Momentum Breakout
fullReport.html: E3v2 Momentum Long keeps its filter off for the equity index. NQ is below its 29,541 ATR stop and its regime reference after Friday's flip, so a fresh long here fights the still bearish stop. The one place momentum is working is crude: MCL broke above 86 on strong follow through and holds above a rising stop, the profile a momentum long looks for. The takeaway is that the filter is doing its job on the indices, keeping you out of a long while the trend is unresolved, and pointing at the market that is actually trending.

fullReport.title: AVWAP Deviation Band
fullReport.html: AVWAP deviation band (MNQ): AVWAP center 29,439, close 29,521 is about plus 1.9 sigma, just under the plus 2 band at 29,526. Bands: plus 2 sigma 29,526, plus 1 sigma 29,483, minus 1 sigma 29,395, minus 2 sigma 29,351, minus 3 sigma 29,308. Sigma compressed to 43.8 today from Friday's 87.7. The reversion signal already fired intraday: the 29,354 low tagged the minus 2 band and price mean reverted straight back to the upper band by the close. Volume is unavailable on the continuous contract, so the read is price only. The lesson: a minus 2 sigma tag in a quiet range is a high odds reversion spot, and today it delivered a full trip from the lower band back to the upper band.
